final_announce: Announce: relevant=[object 0, object 1, object 2, object 4]; rule=if object 0 is present, the device turns on only if exactly one of objects 1, 2, or 4 is also present; if object 0 is absent, the device turns on if at least one of objects 1, 2, or 4 is present

Announce: relevant=[object 3, object 4, object 5]; rule=the device is on if (object 3 is present AND objects 4 and 5 are absent) OR (object 3 is absent AND exactly one of object 4 or object 5 is present) — all other objects have no effect
Announce: relevant=[object 1, object 4, object 7]; rule=device is ON if (object 7 is present AND object 1/4 are absent) OR (object 7 is absent AND exactly one of object 1/4 is present)
Announce: relevant=[object 2, object 3, object 6]; rule=the device turns on if exactly one of objects 2, 3, or 6 is included in the set.

Announce: relevant=[object 3, object 4, object 5]; rule=the device turns on if (exactly one of object 4 or 5 is present and object 3 is absent) or (object 3 is present and neither object 4 nor 5 is present)
Announce: relevant=[object 0, object 1]; rule=The device is on if exactly one of object 0 or object 1 is present, regardless of other objects.

Announce: relevant=[object 0, object 4, object 5, object 7]; rule=object 0 must be placed with exactly one of object 4, object 5, or object 7 (no other objects from this group allowed; other objects may be included)
Announce: relevant=[object 0, object 4, object 6]; rule=the device is on if exactly one of object 0, object 4, or object 6 is present (exclusive OR among these three), regardless of other objects
Announce: relevant=[object 1, object 3, object 4]; rule=device turns on if exactly one of object 1, object 3, or object 4 is present

Announce: relevant=[object 2, object 3, object 4, object 5]; rule=the device turns on if (object 3 is absent and exactly one of object 2 or object 5 is present) OR (object 3 and object 4 are both present and object 5 is absent).
Announce: relevant=[object 1, object 6, object 7]; rule=object 1 must be present and objects 6 and 7 must not be present
Announce: relevant=[object 0, object 4, object 6]; rule=the device turns on if exactly one of objects 0, 4, or 6 is placed on it, regardless of the presence of other objects.
Announce: relevant=[object 0, object 1, object 2]; rule=the device turns on when object 2 is present and neither object 0 nor object 1 are present.
Announce: relevant=[object 4, object 0, object 1]; rule=the device turns on if object 4 is present and neither object 0 nor object 1 are present.
Announce: relevant=[object 0, object 1, object 6]; rule=object 1 must be present and objects 0 and 6 must not be present

Announce: relevant=[object 0, object 1, object 2, object 4]; rule=device turns on if (object 0 is present and objects 1 and 4 are not present) OR (objects 1 and 2 are both present and object 4 is not present) OR (objects 2 and 4 are both present and object 0 is not present)
